newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores in new credit agreement.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores in new credit agreement.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said Tuesday it entered into a secured five-year credit facility with a group of lenders for up to $200 million in borrowing.
The company said the new credit line replaces its previous secured $75 million credit facility.

The company also said its wholly-owned subsidiary Specialty Retailers Inc completed a private offering of $200 million principal amount of 8-1/2 percent senior notes due 2005, and $100 million principal amount 9 percent senior subordinated notes due 2007.

The net proceeds from the offering of notes were used to repurchase $130 million principal amount of Specialty's 10 percent senior notes due 2000 and $118.2 million principal mount of 11 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003, and to make consent payments.
Stage Stores operates 328 department stores, located mainly in small towns and communities, under the names Stage, Bealls and Palais Royal.
